messages:
incident-bot: [31mALERT[0m p99 latency spike on /v1/stream at 11:14 UTC — p99 = 6.1s, p95 = 1.8s. Error-rate stable. Potential cause: sudden KV paging and high disk read latency in us-west-2.
Priya: i'm oncall, taking ownership. tagging @eng-runtime Omar and @eng-sre Elena. starting initial triage.
Omar: pulling runtime traces now. I see a big uptick in prefix miss ratio starting at 11:11. New rollout flag `prefixhash_v4` flipped earlier today to 100% at 09:00.
Elena: infra metrics show io_wait up ~4x on several cache nodes and paging ops spiking. p99 aligns with paging surge.
CacheBot: prefix-miss-alert: hostset-7 miss_rate delta +72% since 11:10; hot prefixes redistributed across >12 shards.
Priya: can we confirm whether v4 changed salt/namespace logic (i.e., rehashing) vs just mapping order? need to know if old mapping is reachable.
Omar: v4 applied a new salting function (salt_v2) to reduce hotspotting. but looks like salt changed resulting in widespread prefix relocation. no dual-write/backcompat applied. that created cold prefixes on many nodes.
Theo: PS — customer ops reports streaming pauses in client dashboards. several support tickets opened but low severity for single requests. potential customer impact: higher latency and partial stream stalls.
Elena: mitigation options: 1) roll back prefixhash_v4 immediately (will stop new traffic mapping to v4), 2) enable compatibility-mode routing to map v4 keys to v2 mapping at router layer, 3) bring up read-only cache replicas warmed from snapshot, 4) throttle long-tail streaming to shed load. fastest = rollback flag.
Priya: rollbacks sound safest. Omar — how long to flip? any service restarts?
Omar: it's a config toggle: `PATCH /internal/flags/prefixhash_v4 {"enabled":false}`. no restarts. will stop new requests hitting v4 mapping. existing requests will still see misses until warmed.
Priya: do it and also trigger a targeted pre-warm for top 1k prefixes and temporarily bump cache size/ttl. Elena — can you coordinate pre-warm job?
Elena: creating pre-warm job now. command: ```/ops/prefill --env=prod --prefix-list=/ops/top_prefixes_1000.csv --concurrency=20``` launching in 2m so it doesn't overload paging IO. also increasing cache-eviction-window from 300s -> 1800s to reduce churn.
OpsBot: config change submitted by Omar at 11:18:37 UTC. flag `prefixhash_v4` -> false.
Omar: flag rollback complete at 11:18:40. routing shows new traffic returning to legacy mapping.
CacheBot: prefill job queued and starting split-phase warmup. backoff and concurrency tuned to avoid IO spikes.
Elena: observing metrics: within 3 minutes, miss-rate on previously cold prefixes falling from 78% -> 40%. disk read latency trending down but still elevated vs baseline.
Priya: any observed improvement on p99/p95?
Omar: p99 improved from 6.1s -> 1.6s over 6 minutes; p95 dropped to ~420ms. streaming_stall spans decreasing but a handful of in-flight streams still report multi-second stalls.
SupportBot: sent customers a status note: "We've identified a prefix mapping rollout as the root of transient streaming latency. We've rolled back the change and are warming cache; monitoring for recovery. We'll follow up with timeline and RCA." Theo — flag any customers who escalate.
Theo: will monitor. a customer reported three user-visible slow streams, no timeouts. they will wait for follow-up.
Priya: good. capture timeline and impact for RCA. Omar — can you add a postmortem checklist item: add canary gating for prefix-locality metric and automated prefill when rolling mapping changes?
Omar: yep. proposed long-term fixes: 1) dual mapping during rollout for warm handover, 2) prefix-locality simulation in CI, 3) rollout gate based on delta miss-rate threshold and paging ops.
Elena: also propose an alert for sudden prefix miss delta > 20% on 5m window, and a circuit-breaker that prevents rollouts if paging ops cross threshold.
Priya: assigning owners: Omar -> RC A (rewrite rollouts), Elena -> infra alerts and prefill automation, Theo -> customer comms. ETA initial RCA draft 72h.
CacheBot: monitoring note: p99 stable under SLO at 11:22:10 UTC. continuing observation window 2h per runbook.
Priya: handing active watch to Elena for next 3 hours.
Elena: ack, will watch dashboards and reopen if regression. adding runbook note about prefilling top prefixes automatically on mapping changes.
incident-bot: INCIDENT MITIGATED at 11:22:10 UTC — primary mitigation applied (rollback + prefill). further RCA follow-up scheduled.
Priya: closing the active thread but keeping postmortem open. thanks all.
SupportBot: closing customer notification loop; no escalations outstanding.
